title: DEFCON 21 - DNS May Be Hazardous to Your Health - Robert Stucke
summary: A DEFCON 21 talk by Robert Stucke on DNS errors caused by single-bit flips, which lead to requests for misspelled domains. It shows real-world data on bitsquatting.
why: Cited in threads on ECC memory, CPU reliability, and bitsquatting as evidence that bit flips cause real DNS misdirection.

quote.text: you might find the DEFCON talk on single bit domain errors relevant
